page_title: TOT 2-0 FUL | Tottenham Hotspur v Fulham 23/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' The attendance for today's match is 61286.
90+5' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
87' Tom Cairney (Fulham) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the top left corner. Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
85' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
84' Great save! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Guglielmo Vicario.
82' A substitution has been made. Joao Palhinha is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from James Maddison as he is replaced by Alejo Veliz (Tottenham).
82' Here is a change. Heung-Min Son is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) for Richarlison.
80' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Antonee Robinson (Fulham) heads on.
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 15:5.
75' James Maddison (Tottenham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harrison Reed (Fulham) comes onto the pitch for Sasa Lukic.
71' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
69' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and Anthony Taylor interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Tottenham will take a free kick near the side line.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is adjudged offside.

64' The most active player in today's match is definitely James Maddison (Tottenham). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
62' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
62' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is being substituted because of an injury. Ange Postecoglou sends Oliver Skipp on the pitch.
61' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
58' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
57' Willian (Fulham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emerson Royal (Tottenham) is coming onto the pitch as Destiny Udogie cannot continue after picking up an injury.

54' 2 - 0 Heung-Min Son produces a sweet pass and picks out James Maddison (Tottenham) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:0!
54' The free kick is delivered by Willian (Fulham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
53' Dangerous play by Destiny Udogie (Tottenham). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham will take a free kick.
52' Richarlison (Tottenham) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
50' Fulham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Half-time substitution. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is replaced by Alex Iwobi.
46' The game is over for Carlos Vinicius (Fulham). Raul Jimenez comes on for the second half.
46' Referee Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Heung-Min Son picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
42' The corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is intercepted by the defence.

42' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
41' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes a short corner kick.

40' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
40' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
40' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
40' A pass lands at the feet of Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
39' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared.

38' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
36' 1 - 0 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a mazy run and finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper. He lashes the ball into the top right corner, giving the keeper no chance.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

34' James Maddison (Tottenham) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Bernd Leno.
33' Willian (Fulham) attempts to find Carlos Vinicius with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
31' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
30' Richarlison (Tottenham) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the right post.
28' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Bernd Leno thwarts him with a nice save.
26' The flag is raised and Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is offside again, not for the first time today.
25' High and wide! Sasa Lukic (Fulham) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
24' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Guglielmo Vicario has no trouble gathering it.
20' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
18' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
18' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
15' Tottenham are seeing far more of the ball now.

12' What a great chance for Joao Palhinha (Fulham). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
11' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) prepares to take a corner kick.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham). Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Flag goes up against Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.

8' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. Tottenham earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
7' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches over the bar!
7' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Joao Palhinha (Fulham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
5' Richarlison (Tottenham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
